newsitem.title: USA: Frankfort to trade ex-dividend June 25.
newsitem.headline: Frankfort to trade ex-dividend June 25.

text.p: Frankfort First Bancorp Inc said Tuesday that it had been informed by the Nasdaq Stock Market that its common stock would not trade as "ex-dividend" until the first business day following the payment of its special dividend or June 25, 1997.
Frankfort said Nasdaq cited the size of the company's previously announced $4.00 special cash distribution in relation to the trading price of its common stock.

Consequently, Frankfort said, parties purchasing shares of common stock through the Nasdaq Stock Market during the period between June 18 and June 24 will be entitled to receive the special distribution in lieu of the seller.
Such payment will come from the seller, not the company, Frankfort said.
